annotations.title: Signed proof of reserves for kUSD

description: The latest signed proof of reserves for kUSD, the Kerne stablecoin on Base: outstanding kUSD, the USDC held in each PSM contract, the solvency ratio, skUSD share price and the hedge account, all read on chain at one pinned block and signed every 15 minutes by a dedicated key that holds no funds. The hash and the signer are checked here before the result is returned, and the result says whether they checked. Set include_signed_bytes to true to get the exact signed string so you can check it yourself.

include_signed_bytes.description: Also return signed_payload_canonical, the exact string that was hashed and signed. Default false.

name: get_signed_reserves
